reviews.quote: The ROG Zephyrus G16's 2025 update offers several upgrades... The input devices and speakers remain very good. (NBC 'very good' 90%, 2025 GU605CX; no 2026 GU606 pro review retrieved — same chassis/OLED family assumed.)

professional.note: No 2026 GU606 pro review found 2026-11-24; ratings inferred from 2025 GU605 line anchor (same chassis/display family) with CPU-refresh delta.

praises: Same OLED 240Hz + aluminum chassis as the acclaimed 2025 model (BBY line pool 4.65+/5) with a faster Arrow Lake refresh CPU
5070 + 2.5K OLED remains the sensible gaming match — smooth 2.5K play with DLSS in a 1.85 kg machine
Best-in-class speakers and keyboard/trackpad carry over (NBC line finding)
90Wh battery and USB-C charging keep it usable as a work laptop away from the outlet
Wi-Fi 7 and Thunderbolt 4 keep the platform current for 2026 buyers
complaints: $4,199-4,499 for the same 5070/32GB spec the 2025 model sells for at $3,699.95 — pure refresh tax (no value factor, but buyers notice)
GPU still TGP-capped in the slim chassis; same 8GB VRAM ceiling as 2025
Soldered RAM, 32GB max at this tier
OLED PWM flickering and limited HDR brightness carry over from 2025 (NBC cons)
Lid creak / hinge rocking and idle fan pulsing are unresolved line complaints

design_philosophy: The 2026 refresh of ASUS's thin-first 16-inch flagship: identical aluminum OLED chassis, new Arrow Lake-H refresh CPU, same RTX 50-series GPU stack. This mid config is the volume pick — the philosophy is unchanged: portability and display first, GPU wattage second, now at a refresh-price premium over the still-sold 2025 model.
rating_notes: Inferred from 2025 GU605 NBC 90% anchor per SHARED-zephyrus-g16.md (same chassis/OLED family): 5070-tier deltas (-2.5 gaming vs 5090 anchor, 8GB VRAM caps ai_ml) plus 386H CPU refresh +0.2 productivity / -0.2 battery. No 2026 pro review retrieved — disclosed. Sale price $4,199 (reg $4,499).
